fact: A May 2026 audit found Togo's opendata.gouv.tg portal held 1,550 datasets from many ministries (INSEED 479, Agriculture 26, Public Works among them), published under the portal's declared CC-BY 4.0 open licence.
title: Togo open data audit: 1,550 datasets, 18 months, 0 governance? | Gausoft.dev
